 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The vertical 5 separates two 4x4 patterns. Combine the right pattern
    # into the left only when their colored cells do not overlap; otherwise
    # retain the left pattern.
    split = next(i for i, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 5)
    left = [row[:split] for row in grid]
    right = [row[split + 1:] for row in grid]
    if any(left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0
           for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(split)):
        return left
    return [[left[r][c] if left[r][c] else right[r][c]
             for c in range(split)] for r in range(len(grid))]
